worlds.title: The Spark of Life
worlds.subtitle: Power, LEDs, resistors, buttons
worlds.intro: Welcome to the bench! We start with the oldest trick in electronics: pushing current through a piece of glass until it glows. You will blow one LED on purpose, then learn exactly why it happened.

worlds.title: Signals and Rhythms
worlds.subtitle: Digital & analog I/O, PWM, transistors
worlds.intro: Now the Uno starts talking. Blink patterns become messages, sensors become numbers, and a transistor lets a 40 mA pin command a motor that eats hundreds.

worlds.title: The Power Swap
worlds.subtitle: Transition boss: 5 V to 3.3 V
worlds.intro: One board, one boss fight. Move a working 5 V project onto a 3.3 V ESP32 without letting a single pin see more than 3.6 V.

worlds.title: The Connected World
worlds.subtitle: ESP32 IoT Academy
worlds.intro: Your circuits get a Wi-Fi antenna. Touch pads, addressable pixels, a web server in your pocket, and a weather station that publishes to the world.

worlds.title: Rotor Rising
worlds.subtitle: Brushless power, custom builds, and the first hover
worlds.intro: Four motors, one pack, and physics that does not forgive a sign error.
